name: mcp-pc-bridge
description: A fully self-hosted bridge from ChatGPT to your Windows PC through your own server. Includes Windows GUI, relay, HTTPS/OAuth gateway and deployment scripts.

interface.longDescription: Self-host the entire open-source bridge: Windows GUI and agent, relay, HTTPS/OAuth gateway, deployment scripts and plugin template. No mandatory author-hosted relay account or subscription. ChatGPT and the model are external services; results pass through your server to ChatGPT. Experimental broad Windows-user access: no enforced folder sandbox or per-action approval. Supply your own server, domain, TLS and credentials. The example URL is not a working service.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my configured computer is online without changing files or settings.
